description: Header file defining various utility functions and macros for buffer management, byte order conversions, memory allocation, and other miscellaneous utilities used in the reftable subsystem.

methods.name: reftable_buf_init
methods.description: Initializes a reftable buffer for use, setting length to zero and allocating memory if needed.

methods.name: reftable_buf_release
methods.description: Frees memory associated with the buffer and resets it.

methods.name: reftable_buf_reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer length to zero without releasing allocated memory.

methods.name: reftable_buf_setlen
methods.description: Sets the length of the buffer, writing a NUL byte at the new end.

methods.name: reftable_buf_cmp
methods.description: Lexicographically compares two buffers.

methods.name: reftable_buf_add
methods.description: Appends arbitrary bytes to the buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_addstr
methods.description: Appends a null-terminated string to the buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying memory from the buffer, transferring ownership to the caller.

methods.name: void reftable_put_be16(void * out,uint16_t i)
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: void reftable_put_be24(void * out,uint32_t i)
methods.description: Encodes a 24-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: void reftable_put_be32(void * out,uint32_t i)
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: void reftable_put_be64(void * out,uint64_t i)
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit integer in big-endian format.

methods.name: uint16_t reftable_get_be16(const void * in)
methods.description: Decodes a 16-bit big-endian encoded integer.

methods.name: uint32_t reftable_get_be24(const void * in)
methods.description: Decodes a 24-bit big-endian encoded integer.

methods.name: uint32_t reftable_get_be32(const void * in)
methods.description: Decodes a 32-bit big-endian encoded integer.

methods.name: uint64_t reftable_get_be64(const void * in)
methods.description: Decodes a 64-bit big-endian encoded integer.

methods.name: binsearch
methods.description: Performs a binary search on an ascending range.

methods.name: free_names
methods.description: Frees a NULL-terminated array of malloced strings.

methods.name: parse_names
methods.description: Parses newline-separated list of names into an array.

methods.name: names_equal
methods.description: Compares two NULL-terminated string arrays for equality.

methods.name: names_length
methods.description: Returns the number of strings in a NULL-terminated array.

methods.name: reftable_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory, invocation depends on set allocator.

methods.name: reftable_realloc
methods.description: Reallocates memory, invocation depends on set allocator.

methods.name: reftable_free
methods.description: Frees memory, invocation depends on set allocator.

methods.name: reftable_calloc
methods.description: Allocates zero-initialized memory.

methods.name: reftable_strdup
methods.description: Duplicates a string, allocating memory accordingly.

methods.name: int reftable_alloc_size(size_t nelem,size_t elsize,size_t * out)
methods.description: Calculates allocation size, with overflow check.

methods.name: void * reftable_alloc_grow(void * p,size_t nelem,size_t elsize,size_t * allocp)
methods.description: Doubles allocation size or increases to meet minimum requirement.

ctags.name: reftable_alloc_grow
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void *reftable_alloc_grow(void *p, size_t nelem, size_t elsize,$/

ctags.name: reftable_alloc_size
ctags.pattern: /^static inline int reftable_alloc_size(size_t nelem, size_t elsize, size_t *out)$/
